name: Air-Fryer Cauliflower Wings
ingredients: 1 tsp each garlic powder and paprika
Sauce: 1 tbsp hot chilli sauce, 1 tsp lemon juice, 1 tsp soy sauce
steps: Whisk the besan, cornflour, water, spices and salt into a thin batter. Coat the cauliflower and tofu.
Preheat the air fryer to 200°C and spray the basket.
Cook in a single layer for 15 minutes, shaking at 8 minutes, until crisp.
Toss with the sauce and return to the air fryer for 3 minutes.
Serve with raw vegetables and a yogurt or soy-yogurt dip.
note: A lighter take on buffalo wings with no butter and a fraction of the oil.
